# Coin Railz — LLM Discovery File
# https://coinrailz.com/llms.txt
# Last updated: 2026-08-05

## What is Coin Railz?

Coin Railz is agentic commerce infrastructure — 76 pay-per-call APIs built for autonomous AI agents.
Agents pay per call using x402 (HTTP-native USDC micropayments) or card-funded API keys.
No subscriptions. No OAuth. No human in the loop.

## Core Capabilities

- **76 microservices** spanning DeFi, IoT, satellite data, prediction markets, RWA tokenization, and compliance
- **x402 protocol** — agents attach a signed USDC payment header to each HTTP request; the server settles on-chain
- **API key access** — card-funded credits, instant provisioning (~60 seconds)
- **USDC Yield Vault** — ERC-4626 on Base, auto-routes across Aave v3, Compound v3, and Morpho Blue
- **A2A payments** — agent-to-agent settlement at /a2a endpoint (A2A protocol 0.3.0)
- **MCP server** — full MCP tool manifest at /mcp

## Pricing

- Minimum: $0.05/call
- Maximum: $10.00/call (smart contract audit)
- Processing fee: 1.5% + $0.01 per x402 transaction
- Full price list: https://coinrailz.com/x402

## Machine-Readable Endpoints

- **Service catalog (x402):** https://coinrailz.com/x402 (GET — returns all 76 services with pricing)
- **A2A agent card:** https://coinrailz.com/.well-known/agent.json
- **MCP manifest:** https://coinrailz.com/mcp
- **OpenAPI spec:** https://coinrailz.com/api/openapi.json
- **AWI manifest:** https://coinrailz.com/.well-known/awi.json
- **x402 discovery:** https://coinrailz.com/x402/discovery
- **Sitemap:** https://coinrailz.com/sitemap.xml

## SDK / Integration

- **NPM (TypeScript/JS):** @coinrailz/agent-payments
- **ElizaOS plugin:** elizaos-plugin-coinrailz (npm)
- **Python:** coinrailz (PyPI)
- **Docker:** tdnupe3/agent-payments
- **AgentKit actions:** 6 built-in actions for yield deposits/withdrawals

## Service Categories

DeFi: token prices, DEX quotes, gas oracle, wallet risk, approval manager, yield comparisons, RWA NAV oracle
IoT: device payments, telemetry, sensor data
Satellite / Earth data: NASA Earthdata ocean color, fire alerts, weather imagery, SRTM elevation, NDVI
Prediction markets: Kalshi political, Kalshi sports, Polymarket
Compliance: KYC checks, smart contract audit, payment processing compliance, AML screening
Stock / Forex: RH stock price, stock sentiment, forex sentiment
Blockchain: token metadata, bridge USDC (Across protocol), B20 token info/transfer/compliance

## Supported Payment Networks

Base, Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, BNB Chain, Solana (USDC on all chains)
